2609.35521.title: Beyond Token Scale: Chunk-Level Sparse Autoencoders for Reliable Semantic Feature Discovery
2609.35521.paper_summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose features that help us understand and steer language models, but faithful reconstruction does not guarantee informative concepts. Token-level objectives reward lexical and formatting details alongside semantic content, all competing for a limited sparse budget. We introduce a family of chunk-level SAEs that encode mean-pooled activations over chunks, each a contiguous span of tokens: Mean-Chunk reconstructs the observed chunk, Cross-Chunk predicts an independently processed neighbor, and Joint-Chunk combines both targets. These designs separate the effect of a larger observation unit from that of predicting information shared across passages. With matched training data, chunk-level SAEs remain powerful interpretability tools while learning reliable semantic features that capture high-level concepts and respond selectively to relevant content. Their strengths are complementary: Mean-Chunk improves high-level feature discovery, reasoning detection beyond surface cues, and steering; Cross-Chunk leads document retrieval and classification transfer while producing selective, persistent features. Changing what an SAE sees and predicts yields reliable semantic features for more meaningful tasks. We demonstrate their practical value through gains across downstream tasks such as retrieval, reasoning detection, and steering.
2609.35521.paper_summary_zh: 稀疏自編碼器（SAEs）揭示了幫助我們理解和引導語言模型的特徵，但忠實的重建並不保證能夠提供有意義的概念。令牌級目標在語義內容的同時獎勵詞彙和格式細節，所有這些都在有限的稀疏預算中相互競爭。我們介紹了一系列塊級 SAEs，這些 SAEs 對塊的均值池化激活進行編碼，每個塊都是連續的令牌範圍：Mean-Chunk 重建觀察到的塊，Cross-Chunk 預測獨立處理的鄰居，而 Joint-Chunk 結合了這兩個目標。這些設計將較大觀察單位的影響與預測跨段落共享信息的影響分開。通過匹配的訓練數據，塊級 SAEs 仍然是強大的可解釋性工具，同時學習可靠的語義特徵，捕捉高層概念並對相關內容作出選擇性反應。它們的優勢是互補的：Mean-Chunk 改進了高層特徵發現、超越表面線索的推理檢測和引導；Cross-Chunk 引領文檔檢索和分類轉移，同時產生選擇性、持久的特徵。改變 SAE 看到和預測的內容會產生可靠的語義特徵，以便於更有意義的任務。我們通過在檢索、推理檢測和引導等下游任務中的增益來展示它們的實際價值。
